what: Open /dashboard/seller/{shopId}/products/{productId}/media as a member: heading 'Photos', link 'Back to inventory', tabs Photos/Video, count 'N of 20 photos'; API answers GET gallery 200.
Open the page signed out: redirected to sign-in with a return path back to the photos page.
Open .../products/not-a-uuid/media: Next.js not-found page, no API call to gallery.
Open the page with a shop id that does not exist or is not the member's: not-found page.
Open the page with a valid-looking product id that is not in this shop: loading box, then error panel (404 product_not_found from gallery GET) with Retry.
Open the page with a product id of ANOTHER shop (member of shop A, product of shop B): must show the same error as unknown and no photos of shop B.
While the gallery loads: page skeleton, then grey pulsing box with role=status 'Loading photos'.
Gallery GET fails (500 / network): error panel with a Retry button; Retry refetches and shows the list when it works.
A member without products.read (no such built-in role?) opens the page: Forbidden panel, no gallery request.
Click 'Back to inventory': goes to /dashboard/seller/{shopId}/inventory.
Tab 'Photos' is marked current (aria-current=page).
Click tab 'Video': goes to .../media/video (video page is another area; only the link is checked here).
Text says first photo is the main image and changes apply when you save.
Counter reads 'N of 20 photos' and follows add/remove in the draft (not only saved photos).
Product with no photos: text 'No photos yet. Add the first one.' (a read-only member sees 'No photos yet.' only).
In inventory, row menu entry 'Photos and video' opens this page; shown only with products.write and for active (non-archived) products.
Open the photos page of an ARCHIVED product by URL: list shows, but Save answers 409 product_archived with sentence; menu entry is hidden in inventory.
At 390 px: one column grid, no sideways scroll, up/down/remove buttons at least 44 px, file chooser usable.
At desktop width: 2 columns (sm) and 4 columns (lg) grid of square thumbnails.
Label 'Add photos' with a file chooser that accepts several files and only jpeg/png/webp/avif; shown only with products.write.
Suspended or deleting shop: the chooser is disabled and the reason sentence shows.
When the draft holds 20 photos the chooser is disabled and text 'The gallery holds up to 20 photos.' shows.

Choose one valid PNG: row shows 'Sending', then 'Waiting to process'/'Processing', then the photo appears in the list (draft, not saved yet). DB: Media row PENDING_UPLOAD > UPLOADED > PROCESSING > READY with 3 WebP variants, MediaStatusHistory rows, one media-processing queue message and outbox media.ready.

Step 1 POST /api/shops/:shopId/media/uploads {purpose:'product'} answers 200 with mediaId, upload.url/fields, maxBytes 15728640, 4 content types, and NO key property; DB: Media row with purpose product, shopId, uploaderId.
Step 2 browser POSTs form (signed fields, Content-Type, file last) with no cookie to the storage URL (MinIO, bucket from MEDIA_BUCKET); object appears under media/originals/shops/<shopId>/<uuid>.
Step 3 POST /api/media/:id/complete answers 202 (pending) or 200 (READY/REJECTED); DB: status UPLOADED, uploadedAt set, one queue message after commit.
The storage origin accepts the cross-site POST form from the app origin (CORS + CSP connect-src); no console error.
Choose 5 files at once: five rows, each with its own state, sent in parallel; all appear in the list in finish order.
Choose more files than free room (e.g. 18 existing + 5 new): only the first (20 - existing - active uploads) are sent, the rest are silently dropped with no message.
Choose the same file twice (or the same file again after it finished): two separate uploads and two Media rows; both end in the list (no duplicate refusal).
After choosing, the chooser is cleared so the same file can be picked again.
Drag image files from the desktop onto the page: NOTHING in the code accepts a drop (no drop zone). Check what the browser does (opens the file in the tab and leaves the page?).
Paste an image from the clipboard on the page: not supported in code; confirm nothing happens.
Choose a .gif/.pdf/.txt file: row shows 'Use a JPEG, PNG, WebP or AVIF image.' with Dismiss, and NO request is sent.
Choose a JPEG of 15 MB + 1 byte: row shows 'Each photo can be up to 15 MB.', no request. Exactly 15,728,640 bytes goes through.
Choose a 0-byte file: 'That file is empty.', no request.
Rename a .txt to .jpg (browser says image/jpeg): upload goes through, worker rejects it: row shows "That file isn't an image." (not_an_image); DB Media REJECTED rejectCode not_an_image, no variants.
Upload GIF (browser type image/gif) / SVG: refused in browser (type not in list). Animated WebP/PNG with the right type: worker rejects 'multi_frame' with 'Animated images aren't supported.'
Upload an image over 50,000,000 pixels but under 15 MB: row shows 'That image has too many pixels. Use a smaller one.' (image_too_large); Media REJECTED.
AVIF accepted; HEIC refused in browser. Check an AVIF really becomes READY with 3 WebP variants.
Upload a JPEG with EXIF GPS and orientation tag: the shown photo is upright and the served image has no EXIF/GPS (download and inspect).
Upload the EICAR test file named .jpg: row shows 'That file was blocked by a security check.'; Media REJECTED malware_detected; original deleted from storage. (Scanner must be running in the stack.)
Start 51 uploads that are never completed (API): 51st answers 409 pending_uploads_limit; page shows 'You have too many uploads waiting...' in the row.
More than 30 upload requests a minute per user (or 120 per shop): 429 with Retry-After; row shows rate-limit sentence; not saved as Media rows.
Storage POST fails (offline / 403 / 5xx): row shows "The file couldn't be sent. Try again." with Dismiss; the Media row stays PENDING_UPLOAD and expires later.
Complete called when no bytes arrived: 409 upload_incomplete, row shows "The file didn't arrive completely. Upload it again."
Upload start answers 403 permission_denied (member lost products.write after page opened): row shows permission sentence.
Shop becomes suspended after page open: upload start answers 403 shop_suspended; row shows the suspended sentence.
Session expires during an upload: the session-ended flow runs (sign-in prompt), not a raw error.
POST to our API carries CSRF header; the storage POST carries no cookie and no CSRF header.
Failed row: click 'Dismiss' removes the row only.
Navigate away while a file is Sending or Processing: no warning; the upload is lost for the page, Media row still becomes READY but is attached to no gallery.
Two quick choices of the same file (double change): two uploads (no de-dup); verify no crash.
State text 'Sending' (role=status) while permission, bytes and complete run.
State 'Waiting to process' while status is UPLOADED or unknown; becomes 'Processing' when PROCESSING.
Page asks GET /api/media/:id every 1.5 s until READY/REJECTED/EXPIRED, then stops asking; no request storms for 5 files (5 requests/1.5 s).
READY: photo is appended to the end of the DRAFT (not saved), row disappears, counter rises, Save photos becomes enabled. URLs shown are on the media origin (MEDIA_CDN_URL), end in .webp.
REJECTED at poll time: row turns to the sentence of the rejectCode with Dismiss (all 7 codes have words; unknown code gets the generic sentence).
Complete answers 200 REJECTED straight away (e.g. size_invalid): row shows words at once, no polling.
Slot EXPIRED while waiting: row shows 'This upload expired. Add the photo again.'
Worker not running / queue message lost: row stays 'Waiting to process' forever with no timeout or message; requeue job re-sends after 2 min.
Poll GET /api/media/:id fails (404/500): row shows read-error sentence in an alert; no retry button.
Poll stops when the page is left; coming back does not resume the old uploads (list shows only saved photos).
Upload a copy of another shop's photo: becomes READY normally, no message anywhere, privately flagged (event media.duplicate_suspected).
Same queue message delivered twice: still one READY and one media.ready event.
READY photo has 3 WebP variants 200/640/1600 wide, never enlarged, content-hashed names, image/webp, in bucket under media/derived/; opening each URL returns 200 with nosniff and long cache.
The URL host equals MEDIA_CDN_URL of the stack and is a different site from app and API; image loads on the page (CSP img-src).
GET /api/media/:id of a not-READY photo by another user / another shop's member / anonymous: same 404 as unknown; uploader gets owner view with Cache-Control private,no-store.
GET /api/media/:id of a READY photo by anyone: public view, Cache-Control public,max-age=15, no key or storage address.
GET /api/media/not-a-uuid answers 400 before any database call.
Click 'Move photo N up' (disabled on the first photo): swaps with previous in the draft; positions renumbered; Save photos becomes enabled; nothing is sent yet.
Click 'Move photo N down' (disabled on the last photo): swaps with next in the draft.
Reach the move/remove buttons with Tab and press Enter/Space: works; focus after a move stays usable (check focus is not lost when the clicked button becomes disabled at the ends).
Drag a thumbnail to a new place: NOT implemented (no drag handlers, images draggable by browser only). Confirm nothing reorders.
After a move, the captions 'Photo 1..N' and alt text follow the new order (the label is the position, not the file).
A screen reader hears no announcement of a move (no aria-live).

Move then Save photos: PUT sends mediaIds in the new order and expectedVersion; answer 200 with new order and version+1; DB ProductMedia.position matches; ProductGallery.version +1; event media.gallery_changed in outbox.
Save with an unchanged list is not possible (button disabled until a change); via API an identical list+version changes nothing and writes no event.
Move a photo then move it back: Save photos stays enabled (draft is set) even though list equals saved one; saving it changes nothing (no version bump).
The first photo is the product main image: after saving, the product page and the storefront card use gallery position 0 (feed variant).
There is no 'Make cover/main' button; the only way to set the cover is to move a photo to the top. Confirm no such control exists.
Remove photo 1: photo 2 becomes the main image after save.
Click 'Remove photo N': photo leaves the DRAFT at once with no confirmation; later photos renumber; Save photos enabled. Nothing is deleted on the server yet.

Remove then Save: PUT without that id; DB ProductMedia row gone, ProductGallery.version +1; the Media row STAYS READY (photo is only detached, never deleted from storage; no DELETE /api/media/:id call from this page).
Remove every photo and Save: PUT with mediaIds [] is accepted (200, empty list, version+1); public gallery then empty and product page shows placeholder.

DELETE /api/media/:id: uploader or products.write member; 204 + soft delete (DELETED) when not in a gallery; 409 media_in_use if in a gallery; 409 media_busy if UPLOADED/PROCESSING; other user gets 404. (Not reachable from the page; API only.)
Photos uploaded but never attached stay as READY Media rows (no UI to see or delete them); count and purge rules (purge only for DELETED/terminal).
'Save photos' is disabled until the draft changes, while saving, for read-only/suspended; title shows the reason.
Click 'Save photos': one PUT, toast 'Photos saved', draft cleared, list shows server answer, version updated (next save uses new version).
Double click on Save: only one PUT is sent (button disabled while pending).
Click Save while uploads are still 'Processing': saves the current draft; the finished photos later join the draft but are not saved; no warning.
Button 'Discard changes' (only while draft exists): drops the draft and any error text; pending upload rows stay.
After save, upload another photo and save again: PUT uses the new version, wins 200.
Success toast 'Photos saved' is announced (role=status) and disappears.
Reload after save: same order, same count, same URLs; public product page shows the same.
Gallery of 20: cannot add more (chooser off); API PUT with 21 ids answers 400 validation_failed, nothing changes; PUT with 20 works.
PUT with duplicate id / non-uuid / extra field / bad expectedVersion / bad path id: 400 validation_failed, nothing changes.

PUT with an id of a foreign shop, review photo, unknown id => 422 media_not_attachable failures[not_found]; own unfinished photo => not_ready. Page shows 'Some photos aren't ready yet or no longer exist...' (no per-photo detail).
PUT for a product of another shop / unknown: 404 product_not_found.
PUT for an archived product: 409 product_archived with sentence.
Two tabs: A saves, B saves with old version: B gets 409 version_conflict and a 'Load latest' button; click drops draft, refetches, shows A's version.
Two simultaneous PUTs with the same version: exactly one 200, one 409, one event.
Conflict text: the copy for version_conflict says 'This product changed since you opened it.' (product, not photos): check wording fits.
Suspended shop at save time: 403 shop_suspended, suspended sentence, page refreshes.
Shop DELETING: PUT answers 409 shop_offboarding; the page shows (a) a banner? and (b) a sentence; check controls disabled on load.
More than 60 PUTs a minute per shop: 429 with Retry-After; page shows 'Too many requests' with countdown.
Limiter store down: gallery write answers 503 (fails closed); reads still served (fail open).
Browser offline when saving: error panel/offline sentence; draft kept; Save works after reconnect.
Server 500 on PUT: alert with generic sentence, draft kept.
Next Save or Discard clears the error text.
PUT replay with same body: second answer 200 same state (or 409 stale version); no duplicate rows (unique productId,position).
Each real change writes media.gallery_changed with the outbox in the same transaction; the search index (S32) / product page see the new first image.
Make a change (move or remove), click 'Back to inventory' or a sidebar link: NO warning, draft is lost silently.
Make a change, press reload/close tab: no beforeunload prompt.
Make a change, click tab Video then back: draft is lost, no warning.
Make a change, press browser Back: draft lost, no warning.
While a draft exists, another editor saves; background refetch does not overwrite the draft (draft wins until Save -> 409).
OWNER sees chooser, move/remove, Save photos; all work.
ADMIN same as OWNER if the role has products.write.
STAFF: check which permissions it has; with products.write the controls show, without them the page is read-only.
VIEWER (no products.write): sees photos and counter, NO chooser, NO move/remove buttons, NO Save button; direct PUT answers 403 permission_denied; upload start 403.
Member without products.read: Forbidden panel; GET gallery 403.
User signed in but not a member of the shop: page not found; gallery GET hidden 404; upload 404.
Unauthenticated calls to upload start, complete, PUT gallery, DELETE: 401; GET media/:id for READY works.
Another signed-in user calls POST /api/media/:id/complete or DELETE on my media id: 404 same as unknown, nothing changes.
Uploader who lost products.write calls complete for a shop photo: refused.
ACTIVE shop: everything works.
SUSPENDED shop: photos visible, chooser/move/remove/Save disabled (buttons hidden or disabled), sentence 'This shop is suspended...' visible; API writes 403 shop_suspended.
DELETING shop: same read-only behavior; writes 409 shop_offboarding.
When the shop is deleted, its photos and galleries are removed by event (idempotent).
When the product is deleted, its gallery rows are removed (media rows stay).
GET /api/products/:pid/gallery (anonymous): 200 items by position with 3 URLs each, Cache-Control public,s-maxage=5; no version, no keys.
Product DRAFT/ARCHIVED/sandbox or shop not ACTIVE/sandbox: identical 404 as unknown product.
Product page shows the first photo (feed size) as the main image, alt = product title; click opens full-size dialog.
With 2+ photos, a strip of thumbnails; clicking one switches the main image; selected has aria-current; labels 'Show image N of M'.
Click the main image: dialog with the full variant; close with Escape/close button; focus returns.
Product without photos (or all fail to load): neutral placeholder block with 'No image available'.
A photo whose image fails to load shows the placeholder.
After the seller saves a new order, a buyer sees the new order on the product page (after at most the 5 s cache).
A photo removed from the gallery is no longer in the public gallery; its old URL may still work (content-hashed).
Product page gallery at 390 px: thumbs strip scrolls sideways, thumbs 56 px, no page overflow.
Storefront product card / search result uses the first photo (S32 index).
Only https URLs are used by the public gallery; an http media origin (as in local dev) shows the placeholder.
Production refuses to start without media_cdn_url (different site), media_bucket and scanner address; scanner off is refused.
Dev stack: MEDIA_BUCKET exists in MinIO, originals under media/originals/ private, derived under media/derived/ readable through MEDIA_CDN_URL.
Originals private, moved to cheaper storage after 30/180 days; media origin sends nosniff, immutable cache, no cookie.
Slots older than 60 min in PENDING_UPLOAD become EXPIRED and their object is deleted.
UPLOADED older than 2 min and expired leases older than 10 min are re-sent, max 100 per run.
Terminal rows older than 7 days removed, max 200 per run, keeping variants used by a live photo.
Only the 12 allowed transitions happen; DELETED final; every move has a MediaStatusHistory row.
GET /api/batch/media?ids= answers in request order, null for not READY, max 100 ids.
600 reads a minute per address then 429 with Retry-After.
Worker time limits (20 s original read, 10 s per variant, 15 s scan, 45 s run).
Scanner gives no verdict: photo never becomes READY; row stays 'Processing' on the page.
media_* metrics are counted per run.
Fifth claim rejects as processing_failed (page shows "We couldn't process that image. Try another file.").
Storage failing on the third variant: retried run keeps first two and reaches READY.
Storage key chosen by server: media/originals/shops/<shopId>/<uuid>; no key in any API answer.
Signed upload permission lasts 600 s and binds size 1..15,728,640 and image/ types: posting 16 MB or text/plain directly to storage is refused by storage.
Posting a second object to a used key after READY changes nothing that is served.
File name like .png is shown as text in the upload row, not as HTML.
Gallery/upload routes with malformed shop or product id answer 400 before DB.
Existing automated checks: gallery-view.test.tsx F6-1..F6-11 and tests/seller-photos.spec.ts (1 journey). Not a coverage claim.
